targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('hour', ts) AS time, CASE WHEN rssi > -60 THEN 'close (in/near house)' WHEN rssi > -80 THEN 'passing by (sidewalk/street)' ELSE 'distant (neighboring properties)' END AS metric, count(DISTINCT device_mac) AS value FROM telemetry.bluetooth WHERE ts > now() - interval '14 days' AND rssi IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Distinct devices per hour, by proximity (last 14 days)

targets.rawSql: SELECT extract(hour from ts) AS hour_of_day, to_char(ts, 'Dy') AS day_of_week, count(*) AS sightings FROM telemetry.bluetooth WHERE ts > now() - interval '30 days' AND rssi > -80 GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Traffic rhythm — sightings by hour of day x day of week (last 30 days)

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('hour', ts) AS time, CASE WHEN device_name IS NOT NULL AND device_name != '' THEN 'named' ELSE 'anonymous' END AS metric, count(DISTINCT device_mac) AS value FROM telemetry.bluetooth WHERE ts > now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Named vs anonymous devices per hour (last 7 days)

targets.rawSql: SELECT max(ts) AS time, device_mac, coalesce(device_name,'(anonymous)') AS name, max(rssi) AS best_rssi, coalesce(metadata->>'vendor','unknown') AS vendor FROM telemetry.bluetooth WHERE ts > now() - interval '5 minutes' GROUP BY device_mac, device_name, metadata->>'vendor' ORDER BY best_rssi DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: What's nearby right now (last 5 min, strongest signal first)
